svg.title: Semantic Golfer - live structured decisions
svg.desc: A looping recording of the real app: yes/no decisions, choosing a category, scoring an issue, and Semantic Golfing. Open the website for playback controls and the interactive demo.

span.span: Give a simple message three useful jobs
